summary: Verified the magic-link 5xx->4xx Cloudflare fix on the preview backend. All 4 magic-link error-mapping cases and all 3 regression endpoints pass (7/7). No 5xx escapes from /api/auth/request-magic-link even when Resend rejects the send; rate-limit path is silent 200 ok:true.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py _send_magic_link_email now correctly maps all Resend failures to HTTP 400 with detail codes (email_delivery_pending_domain_verification / email_send_failed). No 5xx path remains. Detection uses str(e).lower() substring match on 'testing emails to your own' / 'verify a domain' / 'restricted' — reasonable but brittle if Resend rewords the error; consider matching on the Resend error code/name if available.

Rate-limit path in request_magic_link correctly returns silent {ok: true} without leaking timing info, and executes BEFORE _send_magic_link_email so a failed first send does not preclude the silent second call (row is inserted only after send in current code — actually row is inserted before send; verified silent path works).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 3 magic_link + 3 user rows for randomtest*/tester*/ratelimit* emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fix on preview (accent-coach-pro.preview.emergentagent.com) verified. Production has not been redeployed yet per main agent note. Rerun /app/backend/tests/test_magic_link_error.py after prod redeploy to verify same behavior against prod URL.
rca of the issue: Cloudflare intercepts 5xx from origin and returns generic 'origin returned invalid response' error. Original code raised HTTPException(status_code=502) from _send_magic_link_email when Resend refused (test-mode restriction: can only send to Resend account owner until domain verified). Fix maps Resend errors to 400 with a specific detail code so Cloudflare passes through and the frontend LoginModal can render a friendly message. Verified: unverified real gmail -> 400 detail=email_delivery_pending_domain_verification; example.com -> 400 detail=email_send_failed; invalid email -> 400 invalid_email; 2nd call within 60s -> 200 {ok:true}.
